verdict_reason: Prior items #24 and #27 are resolved (issuer gone, key list now compile-checked), but the new outbox-reading helper and test actor data sit in the model file and notification-data.spec.ts keeps its own copy of the read.

todos.issue: withOutbox (184-204), EXPECTED_ACTOR (162-169) and actorWithNullableFields (171-178) put a Mongo connection, a Playwright expect.poll and test-user data into domain/animals/models/db, which holds only types and constants: it is now the only file under domain/ that imports MongoDbClient, expect or @config/users. The outbox read also keeps a second copy beside it: tests/animals/e2e/journeys/dynamics/notification-data.spec.ts:160-170 (a file this PR edits) still opens its own MongoDbClient on the outbox collection, polls by aggregateIdFor and closes it, instead of calling withOutbox.
todos.fix: Must: the outbox model file holds only the event types, key list and aggregateIdFor; reading the outbox (connect, poll for one event, close) has one owner in the test-support layer, and every outbox spec this PR touches, notification-data.spec.ts included, calls it. One way: move withOutbox, OutboxReader, EXPECTED_ACTOR and actorWithNullableFields to a flows/animals-admin (or flows/animals) outbox helper, and rewrite notification-data.spec.ts's read as withOutbox((outbox) => outbox.eventsOf(referenceNumber)) with the poll.
